name: r032.camp_defense_zombie_v001_mcw
description: Zero-credit R032 defense branch based on the accepted native Locker save/reload. The isolated profile receives an exact frozen copy of that saved world; camp patrol routes/orders, threats and all combat/contact outcomes must be established and observed live.

steps.label: operate_r032_patrol_zombie_alarm
steps.objective: First use the advertised native camp roster surface to confirm R032 Assignment Camp at OMT [162,36,0], the same assigned character:25/CAMP_RESIDENT and accepted Locker loadout. Inspect all stationed/assigned NPCs and determine who is actually roster-eligible. Through native Zone Manager UI create and observe a camp-local CAMP_PATROL route; through native camp job assignment set an eligible worker to active patrol duty and advance ordinary world time until native records show order ownership and visible position/route movement. Record every eligible and excluded roster actor. Disclose and journal debug spawning a visible hostile zombie near the live patrol. Let the game advance normally and observe the camp alarm, each eligible guard mobilizing/engaging, their attacks and a real kill. Do not spawn scripted death or directly mutate actor state. Before end, natively save, quit the game process, and reenter the same isolated world; verify character:25 assignment and Locker gear plus patrol assignment/order/route remain and observe continued ordinary guard service.
proof_targets: same native R032 Assignment Camp [162,36,0], character:25 identity, CAMP_RESIDENT and saved Locker loadout before setup
native roster and guard-eligibility evidence for every stationed/assigned follower
native CAMP_PATROL zone and job priority/order owner; actual ordinary patrol route/position movement before threat
explicit journal of debug-spawn setup for a visible hostile zombie
camp alarm with exact actor/time receipt followed by each eligible guard response, movement, attack and zombie kill
native save completion, app process exit and new process generation
post-reload same actor/camp/gear and retained live patrol order/route with continued service
all run/process/bridge artifacts reconciled and safely cleaned
invariants: fixture copy and debug spawn are setup-only, no natural gameplay credit
no direct NPC/camp/mission/inventory/zone/save mutation after fixture installation
no manual combat by player to replace guard response
use current semantic owners and advertised controls only
record every roster guard and explicitly explain exclusions
native save and process replacement required; saved-file inspection does not establish persistence

steps.label: verify_r032_patrol_after_reload
steps.objective: Independently re-observe character:25 at the same R032 Assignment Camp, Locker-equipped inventory, same assigned patrol job/order/route and current movement/service through ordinary native game time. Do not restage or reassign any state.
proof_targets: new game PID generation after native save and exit
same live CAMP_PATROL order/route and guard service continued
invariants: fixture is not reinstalled during continuation
do not reassign patrol or manipulate actor/save state
process replacement and fresh native observations are required
